supersedes: protocol_dev.json go rule (C1_multi P95 TPOT <= 0), which the seed-100 development window missed at +1.08%. That stop decision stays recorded in RESULTS_CN.md; this file re-registers a non-inferiority test at the researcher's request before any formal window of this candidate exists.
candidate: SlowLinkGatedScheduler (scheduler.py, unchanged since the development windows); admitted edges in audit.json

formal.single_note: C1_single admits no detour, so the candidate's admitted edge set equals the canonical set; its formal windows are still run, not reused.

decision.NI1_multi_non_inferior: C1_multi: mean over seeds of the relative P95 TPOT change vs frozen V3 <= +2%, and mean relative throughput change >= -0.5%.
decision.NI2_single_improves: C1_single: P95 TPOT below frozen V3 on all three seeds, and mean relative throughput change >= -0.5%.
decision.relative_change: per seed (candidate - v3) / v3, then averaged over the three seeds
decision.reported_not_decisive: P95 TTFT, completion fraction, end backlog, common-completed P95 TTFT/TPOT, decode batch statistics, paths used
decision.failures: Any failed window is kept as .failure.json and counts as not passing; it is not rerun to fill the table.
decision.no_tuning: scheduler.py, the slow-link threshold and these margins are fixed before the formal windows and are not changed afterwards.
